_doc: ADR-0076 D-A: machine-readable round edit-surface taxonomy. Three surfaces, every git-tracked file classified exactly once. R1 runtime = the scripts/install.js static require() closure, enumerated below and re-derived by test/adr-0076-wiring.test.js - the closure scan is the authority, this list is never hand-maintained. R2 governance = machinery (checkers, builders, runners, bench, hooks, CI) - implementation-round territory, doc-round touchable only via the registered carve-out (ADR-0076 D-B). R3 documentation = free in a documentation round.

R1.name: runtime
R1.rule: files in the static require() closure of seeds.runtime_closure_roots (scripts/surface-taxonomy.js computeRuntimeClosure); enumerated snapshot below - drift between this list and a fresh scan fails the wiring test

R2.name: governance
R2.rule: every git-tracked path not classified R1 or R3

R3.name: documentation
R3.rule: docs/**, .scratch/**, adapters/**, test/adr-*-wiring.test.js, CONTEXT.md, AGENTS.md, README* (root-level README prefix predicate - README.md subsumed, ADR-0080)

documentation: R2 only through the registered carve-out (ADR-0076 D-B)

diff_semantics.zero_product_diff: no R1-surface file touched (redefined under ADR-0076; historical rows keep their meaning)
diff_semantics.governance_tooling_diff: independent dimension recording machinery-SOURCE hand-edits on the R2 surface - may be true while zero_product_diff is also true (the F-4 shape). Mechanism-output artifacts (mechanism_outputs below) are exempt only on faithful regeneration: the diff equals what re-running the registered generator at that commit produces. A HAND-EDIT of an output is a named heavier violation (falsification-adjacent) and must be disclosed in files[] (ADR-0077 D-B; supersedes the earlier phrasing "which R2 files the round touched")
diff_semantics.mechanism_output_diff: optional sibling marker {files, reason} - provenance visibility for mechanism-output touches; never feeds burn-rate; listed files must be in mechanism_outputs; a bare marker with no files hard-fails (ADR-0077 D-B)
diff_semantics.carve_out_used: 0|1 burn-rate marker on the trend-inventory row; two consecutive rounds at 1 raise an advisory

reclassifications.note: residual-rule gap closure - root README-* files classified R2 by rule absence (t20 audit C-1). A trend row dated before this entry may list a matching file in governance_tooling_diff.files without the mislabeled-disclosure failure (the file was R2 at row time); a row dated on/after the effective date fails as before.

mechanism_outputs._doc: ADR-0077 D-B: closed enumeration (never residual - same anti-drift discipline as the R1 closure) of git-tracked, R2-classified artifacts produced by a registered in-repo generator. A faithful regeneration of a member is exempt from governance_tooling_diff.files[] disclosure; a hand-edit is a named heavier violation and must be disclosed. Sibling-class outputs on the documentation surface (docs/governance/anchors.json, docs/rewrite-map.json, the surfaces.R1.files snapshot, the README adr-index block) are named in ADR-0077, not enumerated here - R3 files never enter files[] jurisdiction, so the exemption question does not arise for them.

freshness._doc: ADR-0085 two-layer anchor semantics for evidence freshness (grill-t26). claim_surfaces = closed enum of green-verdict-bearing round-dir surfaces; a commit touching them is a claim commit, evaluated at its own commit point by scripts/evidence-freshness.js (single source, no per-suite re-roll). non_anchoring_classes registers the exempt classes; anything unclassified anchors (fail-closed). The SEAL-declaration class is registered non-anchoring effective this round — back-registration for grill-t24/grill-t25 (D-004), in-round for grill-t26. rounds[] registers the round-scoped suites the shared checker serves.

exceptions.requested_by: ADR-0085 registration, grill-t26 (carrier ADR itself awaits the 2026-12-15 countersign tide)
exceptions.reason: the standing next-round taskbook lives under the claim surface handoffs/ but is round bookkeeping, not a verdict claim

exceptions.requested_by: grill-t28 second-party audit - agent-side append to the then-string list; the registration predated the channel and is recorded as a procedural defect (ERRATA E-15), pending owner ratify/revoke (F-8)
exceptions.reason: the second-party audit report is examiner work product resting on the claim surface: residence is not adjudication

exceptions.requested_by: grill-t29 F-9 correction wave (t28 audit finding - imprecise prose claim)
exceptions.reason: forward correction of the sealed t28 report (180+ -> 161); the correction commit is surgical - bound to exactly this commit sha so no later edit rides the exception silently; rebound post-restack ac525728 -> 40362867 (same diff, lane move rebased it)

claim_surfaces.unregistered_signal: warning — fail-closed signaling, not silent pass (D-003 hedge 4)

seal.tag_convention: adjudicated/<round> annotated tag co-names the declared sha (bare sha in the annotation); divergence = explicit drift code; absent tag degrades to declaration-only + recorded state (never silent, never fail-closed)
seal.retires: the cross-round recursive-invalidation (live-HEAD-walk) invariant and its re-capture waves — retired whole, registered here per D-001 anti-ratchet

orphan_ancestry._doc: grill-t28 D-005/D-006: standing pinned-sha ancestry leg - a violation-instance of the existing claim-point contract (ADR-0085 amendment note 2026-09-26). pin_patterns are strict line forms over committed round artifacts; errata_exemptions is THE registered errata list for suppressed orphans (empty = none); the workspace trigger clause evaluates only where the GitButler workspace ref exists (maintainer lane) - absent on public clones/CI it reports not-evaluated, never a silent pass. Residual exposure window (F-6): the interval between a restack/undo that orphans a pinned sha and the next gate evaluation is covered by the post-restack ritual in AGENTS.md, not by this leg alone - the leg runs at gate time, the ritual is the human contract between evaluations. Human-only adjudication points (F-7): errata adjudication, re-seal authorization, trigger interpretation, and waiver issuance are owner acts - the agent reports state, never issues verdicts.

errata_exemptions.reason: audit window captured-at-head pin names b61d7951, the t29 post-seal claim commit; the fix-window uncommit of terminal wave c2768fc8 (E-17) rebased that claim to a new sha - the pinned sha survives only as an orphan object, an expected consequence of the disclosed repair
audit report captured-at-head names 8942e2d8 - the impl-lane tip at audit entry; the fix-window uncommit+rebuild of the closeout tail orphaned it (E-18 class, disclosed in the audit report itself)
re-audit report captured-at-head names c22c01ae - the audit-lane content tip at re-audit entry; the loop-2 repair restack of the audit lane orphans it (E-19 class)

field_governance._doc: ADR-0086 (grill-t29): registry-field governance. Every field of this taxonomy carries exactly one class - fenced (semantics-bearing; consumed by gates/verifiers; changes ride an ADR + countersign), exception-channel (deviation entries; register-and-effective immediately under the pending-confirmation lifecycle), or editorial (bookkeeping/provenance; free edits). The classification map is nested: a string value classifies that subtree wholesale, an object descends to finer paths. The block itself is fenced. Enforcement legs: exception-channel completeness + consumption-vs-classification consistency (gates.json orders 220/221).

exception_channel.lifecycle: registration effective immediately; expires_at mandatory; unadjudicated pending entries auto-lapse at expiry (they suppress nothing and fail the completeness leg until adjudicated or removed); owner-only actions: ratify / revoke / delete / narrow; reversal path is a new ADR

host_admission._doc: ADR-0087 D-A/D-C: per-host declared-unverified surfaces register here under the ADR-0086 exception-channel lifecycle (pending-confirmation effective on registration, auto-lapse on expiry, owner ratify/revoke). Verified surfaces are NOT registered here - absence of an entry means verified or absent, per the adapter README tiering table.
